#!/usr/bin/env python3
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
D=Path('/home/name/.hermes/cache/scratch/edit-replace-review')
ROOT=Path('/home/name/Documents/420-EMBDX/A')
LOG=D/'execution.log'; LEDGER=D/'evidence.json'
def digest(x): return hashlib.sha256(x).hexdigest()
def run(label,cmd,cwd=ROOT,env=None,expected=0,timeout=600):
 start=time.monotonic()
 try:
  p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=cwd,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=timeout)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
  p=subprocess.CompletedProcess(cmd,124,e.stdout or b'',e.stderr or b'')
 with LOG.open('ab') as f:
  f.write(('\n=== '+label+' ===\nCWD '+str(cwd)+'\nCOMMAND '+repr(cmd)+'\n').encode()+b'STDOUT\n'+p.stdout+b'\nSTDERR\n'+p.stderr+('\nSTATUS '+str(p.returncode)+'\n').encode())
 items=json.loads(LEDGER.read_text()) if LEDGER.exists() else []
 items.append(dict(label=label,command=cmd,cwd=str(cwd),status=p.returncode,expected=expected,seconds=time.monotonic()-start,stdout_sha256=digest(p.stdout),stderr_sha256=digest(p.stderr)))
 LEDGER.write_text(json.dumps(items,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(label,'status',p.returncode,(p.stdout+p.stderr).decode(errors='replace')[-1400:])
 assert p.returncode==expected,(label,p.returncode,expected)
 return p
if __name__=='__main__':
 normal=Path('/home/name/.hermes/cache/scratch/edit-replace-integration/independent-review-normal')
 sanitized=normal.with_name('independent-review-sanitizer')
 for target in [normal,sanitized]:
  env={**os.environ,'ASAN_OPTIONS':'detect_leaks=1:halt_on_error=1','UBSAN_OPTIONS':'halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1'}
  for program,prefix in [(target/'build/edit-replace',[]),(target/'build/main',['--prefix','edit-replace'])]:
   run('finite-oracle-'+target.name+'-'+program.name,['python3',str(D/'oracle.py'),str(program),*prefix],cwd=target,env=env)
 run('six-negative-controls',['python3','/home/name/.hermes/cache/scratch/edit-replace-integration/negative.py'])
 run('readme-wrapper-count-green',['python3','-c',"from pathlib import Path; s=Path('/home/name/.hermes/cache/scratch/edit-replace-integration/README.md').read_text(); assert 'Fifteen commands also' in s; print('16 builtins/15 wrappers documentation consistent')"])
 p=run('global-format-inherited',['make','format-check'],cwd=normal,expected=2)
 import re
 paths=sorted(set(re.findall(rb'(src/[^: ]+\.[ch]|tests/[^: ]+\.[ch]):\d+',p.stderr)))
 expected=sorted(x.encode() for x in ['src/cmd_spec.h','src/traverse.c','src/traverse.h','tests/test_help.c','tests/test_output.h','tests/test_recursive.c'])
 assert paths==expected,(paths,expected)
 for path in paths:
  b=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+path.decode()],cwd=ROOT)
  assert (normal/path.decode()).read_bytes()==b
 print('six format failures proved HEAD-identical')
